$comment: Forged Light 2, revised 2026-11-13 to the developer-tool look and, the same day, to a lifted, tinted palette (ADR-136, second revision). The single source of the design tokens: `cargo xtask design-tokens` writes tokens.css into every surface and `--check` fails CI when a copy drifts. Keys under each group are custom-property names without the leading `--`; nested groups join with `-` (type.type-body.size -> --type-body-size). Keys starting with `$` are comments. A new colour role is a change here with a contrast pair below, never a literal in a surface's stylesheet (`cargo xtask design-tokens --literals <dir>` finds them).

theme.$comment: One meaning per colour: teal = trust, secure, the primary action; bronze = value, coins, proof, warmth; green = verified or confirmed; amber = needs a look, testnet, paused; coral = error or irreversible; blue = information or research; steel = reference. Dark is the brand's home theme and the default when the OS states no preference; its ground is a deep teal-navy, not a hue-free black, so it reads as lit rather than switched off. Light is warm paper, not a grey inversion. surface-1 is a card, surface-2 a raised control or hover row, surface-3 a pressed or selected one. accent-text is the link colour; bronze-text is bronze at body sizes. border-control is the edge of an input or checkbox (3:1, SC 1.4.11); border and border-strong are hairlines. deco-* are translucent large fills for grad-hero and backdrops and are never used for text or meaning. Chart and gradient tokens live here, not in global, because a var() resolves where it is declared: a nested data-theme must re-declare them.

dark.grad-hero: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, var(--deco-teal) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(70% 60% at 100% 100%, var(--deco-bronze) 0%, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface-1) 0%, var(--bg) 100%)

light.grad-hero: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, var(--deco-teal) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(70% 60% at 100% 100%, var(--deco-bronze) 0%, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface-1) 0%, var(--bg) 100%)

font.$comment: Inter for everything (variable, self-hosted, opsz axis); JetBrains Mono for code, addresses, hashes and figures. Manrope is retired.
font.font-mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace

type.$comment: One scale for every surface: 12/13/14/16/20/24/32/40/56. Weights 400/500/600 only. Body 1.5, headings 1.2; display sizes track -0.02em. `size-phone` is the phone step, taken from the same scale.

space.$comment: 4 px base; the step number is px / 4.

radius.$comment: Nothing above 12 px. The pill is for status dots and chips only, never a button or card.

elevation.$comment: flat = surface + border (every card); raised = shadow-md + shadow-inset on hover and selected; floating = glass + shadow-lg (header and the command palette only).

motion.$comment: Short, linear-feeling, no spring or overshoot.

chart.$comment: The series colours are per theme (theme.*.chart-1 to chart-6, in the same hue order in both: teal, bronze, blue, neutral, violet, copper). Status colours are never series colours. Fills are the stroke at chart-fill-alpha.

reduced-motion.$comment: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce zeroes every duration; end states still apply.

chart-distinctness.$comment: Worst OKLab distance between any two series, under normal vision and simulated deuteranopia and protanopia (Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes 2009, severity 1.0, applied in linear sRGB). Below min-distance two series read as one at chart sizes; the xtask test fails. The threshold is a design rule, not a standard.

contrast-pairs.$comment: [foreground, background, use] or [foreground, background, use, theme]: every pair a component renders, checked in both themes (or the named one) by the generator (WCAG 2.x). use is text (4.5:1), large-text or non-text (3:1), or separation (1.25:1, a house rule for a panel against the ground, not WCAG). Translucent roles (border, accent-subtle, glass, deco-*) are not measurable on their own and are not listed. The generator refuses the file when a pair from its required matrix is missing.
